Implemented Star Brightness (Miếu/Hãm) for Phụ Tinh and Tuần/Triệt notation for Chính Tinh.

Verified Major Cycle (Đại Vận) calculation logic. Confirmed that calculating Stem of Major Cycle via Ngũ Dần Độn and an-ing stars for each decade is correct and advanced.
Integrated and verified Expert Prompt v5.0 with strict Rule #8 to prevent AI hallucination and ensure methodology strictness.
Fixed tinhTieuHan calculation to start from Tứ Mộ (Tam Hợp)宫 instead of Chi Năm Sinh.

errors_encountered.error: Missing Thiên Thọ star in prompt
errors_encountered.solution: Identified that .find { it.contains('Thân cư') } failed because of palace labeling order. Fixed by passing raw indices to the calculation method.

decisions_made.decision: Use Raw Indices for Star Placing
decisions_made.reason: String-based lookup in palace functions is too fragile for core astrological calculations.
